highlights: E-bike subscriptions are also called e-Bike memberships. This fairly recent concept is changing how people access the world of e-Bikes, especially in cities.
An e-Bike subscription is a service that lets you ride an e-Bike for a monthly fee.

web.description: Learn how e-bike subscriptions work and what they include.

web.title: E-bike vouchers in 2026
